summary: SLOOP's four-track groovebox with added USB video: the FM-1 appears to a computer as a webcam and streams music-reactive visuals, so apps like OBS can show them without a capture card.
features: Over 30 visual modes: scopes, geometry and feedback-style effects
320x240 MJPEG video at 30 fps, with USB audio and MIDI
SCREEN mode streams the FM-1's own display
Autopilot changes mode and palette every 4 to 32 bars
EYESY-style knob controls; visuals have their own MIDI channel
Synth engines, sequencer and drums come from SLOOP
